subject: prd/argus-boundary-enforcement
statement: If If a supported CLI's hook surface fails open by default (e.g. Cursor), then the system shall require the adapter to set the fail-closed option, and if none exists, document the gate/CI backstop as that CLI's guarantee
intent: (operator) a stated per-CLI guarantee, never a silent fail-open
fit_criterion: a per-CLI adapter fixture proves fail-closed, or the CLI is listed with the merge-boundary backstop as its guarantee
